subject: Proposed mutual action plan + 90-minute ML/Infra runthrough
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & mutual action plan — 90-min ML/Infra runthrough

Hi Liam — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the technical runthrough with the infra and ops teams.

Summary from our discovery call:
- Goals: validate inference latency for your batched billing flows, confirm data ingress patterns, and evaluate fallback routing for cost control.
- Primary success criteria: sub-200ms p50 for 512-token typical requests, ability to fail-over to quantized variant without user-facing errors, and a clear view into token-level billing.

Suggested next step: 75–90 minute technical runthrough where our ML infra engineers will:
1) review your current architecture and traffic profile (15m)
2) walkthrough Redwood Serving runtime and fallback policies (20m)
3) run a short sample workload + profiling (25–30m)
4) discuss rollout & mitigations, billing/PO path and open items (15–20m)

Proposed audience: your infra/ops lead + product sponsor; from Redwood: Karthik (ML infra), Neha (CS), and Marissa (Sales Engineer) for demos.

I've attached a draft agenda and a short SOC2 brief you requested. Two asks: could you confirm the attendee roster, and share a couple of 2-hour windows next week in your TZ?

Attachments: proposed-agenda.md (text/markdown), SOC2-brief.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@greenwave.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, ops@greenwave.ai
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & mutual action plan — 90-min ML/Infra runthrough

Thanks Hannah — that recap is helpful.

Quick notes from our side:
- Our infra lead Jenna can't make mornings PT next week, but afternoons work.
- We also need to pull procurement into the thread for PO/terms questions (I copied Marta from CloudProcure; she handles our vendor intake).
- We do want a short live profiling run; could you confirm whether Redwood needs sample traffic or if remote replay is fine?

Slots that look best for us (PT):
- Wed 5/28 1:00–2:30pm PT
- Thu 5/29 3:00–4:30pm PT

I'll let Marta chime in on procurement lead time. If those windows don't work, we can expand.

Liam
Liam Chen
Head of Platform, GreenWave AI
liam.chen@greenwave.ai

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@cloudprocure.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 19:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & mutual action plan — 90-min ML/Infra runthrough

Hi all — looping in procurement questions. I can join the technical session to observe contract/usage implications, and will need the following before we can issue a PO:
1) High-level pricing worksheet or ballpark monthly spend estimate
2) SOC2 report or summary (PDF is fine)
3) Billing contact and Redwood billing address for the PO

We generally have a 10–15 business day lead for new vendors once we receive paperwork.

If you can share the pricing worksheet and SOC2 brief before the session, that would help speed things.

—Marta
Marta Ruiz | Vendor Intake, CloudProcure (on behalf of GreenWave)
marta@cloudprocure.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@greenwave.ai>, Marta Ruiz <marta@cloudprocure.com>

Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & mutual action plan — 90-min ML/Infra runthrough

Hi Liam and Marta — thanks. Good call to have procurement on the session.

We can do remote replay for the profiling run; if you prefer we can also stream a short live workload (we'll need a temporary API key). Either is fine.

Proposed confirmed slots (PT):
- Wed 5/28 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 5/29 15:00–16:30 PT

Please pick one and I'll send a calendar invite. Marissa (SE) will lead the profiling demo; Karthik will own architecture discussion.

Attached: a one-page pricing worksheet (mutual_action_plan.xlsx converted to PDF), updated agenda with timeboxes. Also adding a short link to a Drive packet with the SOC2 summary and our standard PO/billing details.

Doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C4
HubSpot: HS-5821

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), proposed-agenda.md (text/markdown), SOC2-brief.pdf (application/pdf)

Next steps: please confirm preferred slot and the attendee list (Jenna, procurement, product). Once confirmed we'll lock the invite and send a lightweight prep checklist for your team.

Best,
Hannah
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

I'll assemble a 1-page prep checklist (what we need from GreenWave: sample payload format, expected QPS, and an anonymized sample traffic file if you choose replay). Sending that as an addendum in a follow-up.
